reason: The paper presents a general multi-model machine-learning inference server and evaluates it on GoogLeNet, LeNet, ResNet-50, SSD-MobileNet and VGG-16, including image/game/traffic workloads. Its gpu-let spatial partitioning improves throughput for these classical ML models, but the primary paper does not target LLM inference, LLM serving, or LLM-specific memory/compute costs. It is outside this LLM-inference-focused scope.
title: Multi-model Machine Learning Inference Serving with GPU Spatial Partitioning
